The main idea of this deck is to quickly overwhelm your opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. By utilizing cards like Make Disappear to remove threats, Resolute Reinforcements to pump your board, and Valiant Veteran to anthem your team, you can push through damage efficiently. Recruitment Officer helps you dig for key creatures, while Yotian Frontliner and Zephyr Sentinel provide a solid early game presence. With a mix of evasive threats like Harbin, Vanguard Aviator and efficient blockers like Skrelv, Defector Mite, this deck aims to close out the game swiftly.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and disruptive spells to control the board and pressure the opponent. By combining evasive threats like Graveyard Trespasser and Evolved Sleeper with removal spells like Go for the Throat, the deck aims to quickly chip away at the opponent's life total while keeping their own board presence intact. Liliana of the Veil provides additional disruption, while Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Gix, Yawgmoth Praetor serve as powerful finishers. The deck seeks to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of aggression and control.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay utilizing a combination of graveyard recursion, disruption, and efficient creatures to overwhelm the opponent. It aims to control the board with removal spells like "Go for the Throat" and "Cut Down", while utilizing cards like "Make Disappear" and "Evolved Sleeper" to maintain pressure. The inclusion of powerful creatures like "Sheoldred, the Apocalypse" and "Gix, Yawgmoth Praetor" provides additional threats that can quickly close out the game. With a mix of disruption and aggression, this deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while mounting a relentless assault.

The main concept of this deck is to control the board and opponents' strategies through counterspells, removal, and card advantage. The focus is on keeping the opponent's threats in check while developing a board presence with creatures like Serra Paragon and Spirited Companion. The deck also aims to generate value through cards like The Celestus and Wedding Announcement. By utilizing a mix of control elements and proactive threats, this deck aims to outlast opponents and secure victory through attrition.

This deck focuses on controlling the board with removal spells like "Go for the Throat" and "Cut Down", while also putting pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures like "Evolved Sleeper" and "Faerie Mastermind". The deck also utilizes graveyard recursion with cards like "Sheoldred, the Apocalypse" and "Ertai Resurrected" to out value the opponent. With a mix of control and aggression, this deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while steadily building up its own board presence to secure a win.

The key strategy of this Dimir Aggro deck is to quickly disrupt and control the opponent's board with removal spells and disruptive creatures, while also applying pressure with aggressive creatures to close out the game quickly. The deck utilizes a combination of hand disruption, removal, and graveyard recursion to control the game and push damage through efficiently. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's plans early on and build a strong board presence to overwhelm them before they can recover. This aggressive and disruptive playstyle is the focal point of the deck's strategy.

The deck focuses on using a combination of control spells and powerful creatures to dominate the battlefield. By utilizing cards like Leyline Binding and Archangel of Wrath to control the opponent's board, along with creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Mirrex to apply pressure, the deck aims to maintain control while steadily building up its own forces. The inclusion of cards like The Wandering Emperor and Boseiju, Who Endures adds versatility and resilience to the deck, allowing for various strategic options depending on the opponent's actions.

This deck focuses on aggressive strategies with a mix of white and black cards in an Esper color combination. It aims to quickly deploy threats like Dennick, Pious Apprentice and Raffine, Scheming Seer, while disrupting the opponent with cards like Make Disappear and Go for the Throat. The inclusion of powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and The Raven Man provides additional pressure to close out the game. Additionally, the deck features a variety of lands to ensure consistent mana production and enable the deck to function smoothly.

The deck focuses on maintaining control over the game by utilizing a combination of removal spells and powerful planeswalkers. By consistently removing threats from the opponent's board and generating card advantage through cards like Phyrexian Arena and Invasion of Tolvada, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent. The planeswalkers in the deck provide additional removal options and win conditions, while the mana base ensures smooth mana production to support the control elements of the deck. Ultimately, the goal is to establish a dominant position on the battlefield and dictate the pace of the game.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by disrupting the opponent's strategy, countering key spells, and removing threats. It uses a combination of board wipes, counterspells, and card advantage to outvalue the opponent and maintain control of the game. The deck also includes win conditions that can close out the game once the opponent is sufficiently locked down. It aims to efficiently deal with threats and prevent the opponent from establishing a dominant board presence, ultimately leading to a victory through attrition and careful resource management.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays utilizing low-cost creatures and token generation. By playing cards like Katilda, Dawnhart Martyr and Generous Visitor, the deck aims to quickly build a board presence and overwhelm the opponent. Cards like Commune with Spirits and Teachings of the Kirin help refill the hand and maintain tempo. The deck also includes some control elements with cards like Ossification to deal with threats on the opponent's side. Overall, the deck aims to maintain pressure and control the board to secure victory.

The deck focuses on establishing control over the game through a combination of powerful spells and creature abilities. By utilizing a mix of board control, creature removal, and mana ramp, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast opponents in long matches. The key strategy involves using cards like Archangel of Wrath and Leyline Binding to control the board, while quickly ramping up mana with spells like Herd Migration. This control archetype aims to dominate the game with efficient removal and powerful late-game threats like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Etali, Primal Conqueror.

The primary strategy of this deck is to control the board using various removal spells and counterspells while also generating value through cards that provide card advantage. The deck aims to stall the opponent's game plan, disrupt their strategies, and eventually overwhelm them with powerful threats. The inclusion of cards like Teferi, Temporal Pilgrim and Sanctuary Warden allows the player to manipulate the board state and protect their own creatures. By combining these control elements with efficient card draw and creature abilities, the deck can outlast opponents and emerge victorious.

This deck focuses on using efficient low-cost creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive playstyle. By utilizing cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early in the game. Additionally, cards like Recruitment Officer and Steel Seraph provide ways to quickly build up a strong board presence. Overall, this deck prioritizes quick aggression and maintaining board control to secure a victory before the opponent can fully develop their own strategy.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and spells from the Azorius color combination. By utilizing cards like Valiant Veteran and Resolute Reinforcements, the deck aims to establish a strong board presence early on and maintain pressure throughout the game. Cards like Make Disappear and Destroy Evil provide removal options for key threats, while Recruitment Officer and Skystrike Officer generate additional value and card advantage. With a mix of flying creatures and token generators, the deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent to secure victory.
